lean.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 2 ≤ κ)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnd : n < d) (hgap : Real.sqrt κ ≤ (d : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)),
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i)
  let Λ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal eigenvalue
  let μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :=
    multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) Λ⁻¹
  let Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x =>
    ∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) * (WithLp.ofLp x i) ^ 2
  let M : ℝ := ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
  let b : ℝ := ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Q x ∂μ
  0 < M ∧ 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * b ∧
  (1 - Real.exp (-4)) * Real.exp (-3 * (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) ≤ |b| / M ∧
  |b| / M ≤ Real.exp (-2 * (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ)
approved_definition_context: Fin d is the usual finite type with values zero through d minus one; sums run over these coordinates. EuclideanSpace Real (Fin d) has the standard Euclidean norm, and WithLp.ofLp exposes coordinates. Matrix.diagonal is the usual diagonal matrix.

ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian m S is the image of the standard Gaussian by x↦m+toEuclideanCLM(CFC.sqrt S)x. The matrix S is covariance on the positive semidefinite domain; the standard totalized square root is zero outside that domain.

Real and matrix inverses are standard totalized inverses. The displayed integrals are real Bochner integrals with the standard default value zero outside integrability. All finite sums, natural powers, real casts, square root, cosine, exponential, pi and absolute value have their standard meanings.
Subtraction between explicitly real-cast natural numbers is subtraction in the real numbers. Natural subtraction in powers, when present, is truncated natural subtraction.
